evals.prompt: PatientEncounterMode.tsx has 52 useState calls and is 3500 lines. I need to consolidate the state into a useReducer. Don't change any behavior, just extract the state management into a custom hook.
evals.expected_output: A new useEncounterReducer hook that replaces all 52 useState calls with a single useReducer, with stable setter references that match the old setter names
expectations: Creates a new hook file with useReducer
Provides named setters matching original useState setter names
Includes SET_FIELD, SET_FIELDS, UPDATE_FIELD, and RESET actions
No behavioral changes to the component

evals.prompt: The OSCE encounter currently uses modal overlays for OrderPanel and ExamPanel. Convert them to persistent inline sidebar panels in a clinical workstation grid layout. The main content should take 7-8 columns and the sidebar 4-5 columns on medium+ screens.
evals.expected_output: An EncounterWorkstation component with 12-column grid, slot props for panels, and AnimatePresence transitions for sidebar content
expectations: Creates a layout wrapper component with responsive grid
Uses named slot props (children, sidebarContent, orderPanel, examPanel)
Extracts complex JSX into variables before passing as props
Replaces modal overlays with inline panel rendering
Preserves all existing functionality in the sidebar

evals.prompt: QuizView.tsx is 2274 lines. I want to extract the timer logic (elapsed time, pause/resume, display formatting) into a reusable useSessionTimer hook. Make sure the hook returns everything the component currently uses for timer display.
evals.expected_output: A useSessionTimer hook encapsulating timer state, pause/resume, and formatted display values
expectations: Extracts timer-related useState and useEffect into the hook
Returns pause/resume controls wrapped in useCallback
